caption:
In 2012, coal made 39% of UK electricity. In 2025 it made 0.1%.

Two models learned from 2003 to 2012. A straight line said 28% for 2025. Same as last year said 39%.

Both were far off. The models did not change. The world did. Wind went from 5% to 29% of UK power.
